key_insight: ConfSeq is a new language for describing molecular conformations, allowing language models to directly handle 3D molecular structure tasks. This bridges molecular geometry and AI, enabling strong performance on conformer prediction, 3D generation, and molecular representation.
problem_solved: Traditional language models struggle to work with three-dimensional molecular structures because they are not naturally expressed as text. This paper addresses the challenge of representing 3D conformations in a way that AI models can understand and manipulate.
method: Introduces ConfSeq, a conformation description language that encodes molecular 3D structure in a sequence-like form.
Uses this language to adapt language models for key 3D molecular tasks such as conformer prediction and 3D molecule generation.
Evaluates the approach on molecular modeling tasks, showing strong performance for representation and structure-aware prediction.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this provides a practical way to extend language models beyond text into 3D molecular reasoning. It opens the door to more flexible, unified models for computational chemistry and drug discovery.

paper_title: Bridging three-dimensional molecular structures and artificial intelligence with a conformation description language
paper_authors: Jiacheng Xiong, Yuqi Shi, Min Wu, Panpan Shao, Zhaokun Wang
